name: Ukhrul Autumn Trails
objective: Test whether creator content can move interest towards the eastern hills ahead of the autumn season.
targetAudience: 18-35 domestic travellers interested in nature and hill culture
contentRequirement: 45 to 60 second short video plus caption

name: Discover Ukhrul
objective: Promote nature and culture tourism while diversifying demand away from the most concentrated destinations.
targetAudience: 18-35 domestic travellers interested in nature and culture
contentRequirement: 60 second short video or reel plus caption

name: Living Heritage of Manipur
objective: Increase awareness of heritage and living culture experiences in and around Imphal.
targetAudience: 18-45 travellers interested in history and culture

name: Experience Loktak Responsibly
objective: Promote responsible nature travel and encourage longer, lower impact visits to the lake.
targetAudience: Nature and photography travellers who plan trips in advance
contentRequirement: Nature story plus a responsible travel segment

name: Imphal War Heritage Circuit
objective: Build a specialist audience for the Second World War circuit ahead of the commemoration season.
targetAudience: History interested travellers in India and abroad
contentRequirement: One long form video plus three short cuts
